summary: This table presents a financial performance summary for the periods ending September 30, 2025, and September 30, 2024, along with a quarterly comparison for June 30, 2025. Key metrics include revenues, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, with year-over-year growth percentages highlighted. Notably, revenues increased by 3.7% from the previous year, while net profit (after non-controlling interests) rose by 8.0%. The operating margin remained stable at around 21%, with a slight decrease observed in operating profit margin. The table also details earnings per share (EPS) figures, showing a growth of 7.9% for both basic and diluted EPS compared to the previous year.
